task_summary: Identify fastening components, perform fastening, and place tool on workbench.

functional_roles.function: The object that needs to be secured to the workbench.
The specific location on the workbench where the part is fastened.

functional_relations.relation: The fastening_part must be secured to the attachment_target.
The fastening_tool is applied to join the fastening_part and attachment_target.
The fastening_tool is placed on the workbench after use.

operation_pairings.operation: Locate and identify the compatible fastening_part and fastening_tool.
Secure the fastening_part to the attachment_target using the fastening_tool.
Leave the fastening_tool on the workbench.
